svg.title: Перекаты стопы на мяче — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Seated plantar foot rolling with a small firm massage ball UNDER sole. Side three-quarter view, adult in shirt and shorts, one bare working foot visible for clarity, opposite foot firmly on floor. LEFT ball visibly under forefoot near the toes. RIGHT same ball under midfoot closer to heel as foot rolls it backward, toes point forward. Ball stays on floor and in contact with sole in both phases. One small ball only per phase. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
